title: Tadarus books
lead: Written by Markaz Tadarus Indonesia to teach Tadarus of the Qur'an with the 5T method — for adults in study circles, and for children at school and at home.

tadarus.title: The Tadarus al-Qur'an Book
tadarus.text: A reference for teachers and participants of Tadarus circles, and for reading on your own. It covers the mufassal surahs — Qaf to an-Nas — in 4 books.
tadarus.stepsTitle: Every surah is presented with the 5T method

steps.tafsir: A short explanation of their meaning
steps.tazkiyah: Living the verses, in the heart and in deeds

series.name: Juz 30
series.text: An-Naba to an-Nas, with al-Fatihah at the front — the first book.

series.name: Juz 27
series.text: Adh-Dhariyat to al-Hadid, with surah Qaf.

children.title: Qur'anic Education for Children
children.text: A guide to Qur'anic education that shapes a child's Qur'anic character through the surahs from ad-Duha to an-Nas.

features.title: Aim
features.text: Planting faith by learning verses and surahs.

features.title: What makes it special
features.text: Practice tasks that strengthen living by Qur'anic values.

features.title: For
features.text: Kindergartens and primary schools, Qur'an classes, tahfiz schools and families at home.
